items: Stay stylish and comfortable in our short sleeve cowl neck tops for women. Size Guide: X-Small=US 0-2, Small=US 4-6, Medium=US 8-10, Large=US 12-14, X-Large=US 16-18. Please check the size chart before purchase

The fabric is carefully selected from soft, stretchy knit material, which is lightweight and breathable. The slim-fit cut highlights your curves beautifully, while the side ruched design adds layers and visual interest. The cowl collar design is stylish and elegant. It maintains its shape and color even after gentle washing, and the stitching is sturdy and durable. It offers a gentle, feather-light embrace for all body types

items.label: Versatile Style
items.value: The delicate neckline pleats serve as a subtle finishing touch, accentuating your silhouette with an understated vintage-inspired chic. The 3D pleats at the waist flatter your figure seamlessly with leggings, jeans, or skirts. Pair with ankle boots or sneakers to effortlessly channel diverse styles—vintage elegance, casual streetwear, or minimalist workwear—exuding effortless versatility

items.label: Versatile for various occasions
items.value: comfortable and cozy at home, effortlessly put-together for errands or shopping, and easily suiting office needs when paired with a jacket. Great for family gatherings or hangouts with friends, ideal for spring and summer

items.label: Wash Instruction
items.value: Hand/Machine washable with cold water recommended, do not bleach, iron in low, hang or line to dry
